_comment: v3 hooks: prefer the Rust subcommand over the legacy node JS scripts. The JS hooks only look for project-local .agent-teams/runtime/http-mcp.json and ENOENT-fail under v3 user-scope install-global; the Rust subcommand falls back to ~/.team-mode/runtime/http-mcp.json. Once a project has run `team_mode_service install-global`, project-scope hooks here are redundant — they remain only so devs working in this repo before install-global still get hook delivery.
